title: Easy and intuitive data onboarding
content: Setting up a new ingestion pipeline takes just a few steps. Select an incoming data source and format, tune your schema, and let your pipeline run.

title: Built for streaming
content: Providing at-least-once semantics, schema registration (coming soon), and monitoring out-of-the-box. Set up your pipeline and let us handle the rest.

title: Designed for speed and scale
content: ClickPipes provides the scalability you need to handle increasing data volumes, ensuring your systems can handle future demands effortlessly.

title: Simple and extensible
content: ClickPipes leverages our deep ClickHouse expertise to ensure you maximize all of the real time advantages that ClickHouse has to offer.
